technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for Boot-based ModuleRunner implementation
Leverage existing gpfdist sink code for jdbcgpfdist batch job adaptation
Implement REST endpoints using Spring MVC
Use Spring Data for repository abstraction
Apply dependency injection for mock vs real repository separation
Integrate Reactor Stream API into core modules
assumptions: Developer has prior experience with Spring Framework and Spring XD
Existing gpfdist sink code is well-documented and reusable
Documentation for HDFS backed module registry is available
Security properties for GF source are documented in referenced thread
Reactor-based data processor module can be migrated without major refactoring
Test infrastructure supports separation of mocks and real repositories

activities.activity_description: Implement configuration options to allow users to change the default Sqoop metastore to a database of their choice.
Create documentation for configuring HDFS backed module registry as recommended in XD-2287.
Develop REST endpoints to fetch all counters, gauges, and rich-gauges in a single request.
Create a Boot-based ModuleRunner for container-managed environments to run XD without xd-containers.
Configure GF source to work with native GF authentication and document security properties.
Adapt existing gpfdist sink code to create a batch job that reads from JDBC and writes to HAWQ/GPDB using gpfdist protocol.

activities.activity_name: Separate Mocks vs Real Repository Coupling
activities.activity_description: Refactor test infrastructure to separate mocks from real repository dependencies.
Move the project reactor based data processor module from spring-xd-module repo to the core for native Reactor Stream API support.
